d:
For a change, this video is not about highways or infrastructure projects.
Today, I’m taking you on a *train journey from Koraput to Jagdalpur* aboard the *Visakhapatnam–Kirandul Passenger (Train No. 58501).*
This was my *first time travelling on this railway route,* & I wanted to capture the journey exactly as it looked from the train window. From the beautiful hills & dense forests of Odisha to railway bridges, curves, stations & stunning landscapes, this route offers a completely different travel experience.
